test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**whether**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage talks about people from different age groups who should consider making morning walks a part of their routine.
 
• "Whether" is used to indicate that the statement applies to both kids and elders, implying both groups should participate in a morning walk.
 
• Other options like "some", "either", and "neither" do not fit the context of addressing both groups inclusively.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.
